title: Accessibility Conformance Package for Design System Components (tokens, buttons, tables, charts)
creator: Lina Park
description: Create a consolidated accessibility conformance package that documents current state, remediations, and verification artifacts for tokens, interactive controls (buttons, dropdowns), data tables, and charts. Goal is to produce a single, engineering-actionable deliverable we can hand to Platform and Eng teams to close outstanding ARIA, keyboard navigation, and contrast gaps and to feed into the VPAT artifact set. Scope: token contrast mappings, focus ring standards, keyboard interaction models for table sorting/pagination and chart tooltips, ARIA roles/labels for complex components, and a test checklist (manual + automated). Deliverables: remediation plan with priorities, updated token matrix, design specs for focus/hover/active states, sample markup snippets and a checklist + verification runbook for Design QA and Eng verification.
acceptance_criteria: Token contrast table updated with WCAG 2.1 AA pass/fail flags and recommended token replacements
Button and interactive control specs include explicit keyboard behavior, focus visuals that meet 3:1 minimum motion-safe contrast, and ARIA usage examples
Data table interaction patterns documented: keyboard-only sorting + pagination, skip-links for dense tables, and aria-live handling for dynamic updates
Chart semantics defined for screen readers including accessible summaries, data table fallbacks, and keyboard-accessible tooltip focus
VPAT artifact draft (Conformance statement + list of remediations) created and stored in Drive with links to verification evidence
Hand-off package (Figma components, tokens JSON, markup examples, and a verification checklist) delivered to Eng and Platform squads
tasks: Audit existing components in Figma and code: capture gaps and current token usage
Create token contrast matrix (current token -> recommended accessible token)
Design focus states and micro-interaction guidance for buttons and inputs
Define keyboard interaction patterns for tables and confirm with Eng on feasibility
Create chart accessibility pattern: aria-label, longdesc fallback, and keyboard tooltip interaction
Draft VPAT conformance notes and list of nonconformances with remediation timelines
Prep verification runbook and pair with Eng for test automation hooks

Add feature flags for chart longdesc links to avoid UI churn in early rollout.
